assign.outcome:
**Six live, pressable list shapes over one shared team fixture, side by side at [/imagine/design/lists/](/imagine/design/lists/) — drag-to-reassign proven in two of them, two real bugs found and fixed along the way.**

![](1920-level1.png)

One line per shape, from the page's own Notes fold:
- **Rows** — reads fastest, costs nothing but a hairline; no room for a third fact.
- **Title bar** — two real group controls (sort, properties) live at the title; never reaches a person's own detail.
- **Accordion** — one open at a time keeps a long roster to one screen; a closed group hides its members from a scan.
- **Drill-down** — the phone shape: one column, two presses to a person; the groups list is gone while deep in it.
- **Inbox rail** — the rail never moves; an 8rem rail truncates a long group title.
- **Launcher** — the list stays genuinely undisturbed; the sheet hides it entirely while open.

**For the site's own sidebar (a deep page tree, not four fixed groups): shape 4, drill-down** — replace-and-crumb costs nothing extra at any depth, where the accordion only holds two levels before nesting one inside another, and the inbox rail is built for a rail beside a single open item, not a tree you descend into.

**Found and fixed, not just described:** the accordion's own `toggle` handler looped on itself (setting `open` on a fresh `<details name>` fires its own toggle, same tick — 7,384 rebuilds measured in 300ms before the guard); the live "deepest content" px readout used one `requestAnimationFrame`, too early for a page whose own subtree isn't attached to the document yet — every readout stuck at "—" on a cold load until it started retrying across frames; and a `@container` query tried to restyle its own container, so the 400px stack never fired until the container moved one level up. All three are in [`doc/decisions.md`](/imagine/design/lists/doc/decisions.md).

**Left:** keyboard activation (Enter/Space) for the custom pressable rows isn't wired — mouse/touch only; the native accordion (`<details>`) is fully keyboard-accessible on its own, but Rows/Title-bar/Drill-down/Inbox-rail/Launcher's own rows are not, and retrofitting six shapes' worth of key handling was past this task's scope. The `lists-` prefix reservation for `css-scopes.txt` is written to `doc/decisions.md` instead of the file itself — outside this task's write fence.
